tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Dark is the default theme for the fan app.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, post containers, Filament panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, inputs, chips, nested cards on surface.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Never used to carry meaning on its own.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (meets 3:1 against surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, captions, helper text. 4.5:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: FanFolio amber. Primary buttons, money (credits, earnings), active nav, links. One brand action per view.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a brand fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element. Blue so it never reads as a brand action.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed payments, approved KYC, sent payouts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending states: 7-day hold, under review, past-due subscription.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, removals, bans, destructive actions. Also the 18+ badge outline.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind sheets and dialogs; tint over blurred locked media.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control group; tight lists.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; default gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop; gaps between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, media, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Balance chip, avatars, filter pills.
